READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
MISSION: Implement the smallest missing source behavior for selected-guidance attribution and richer hook/format/timing evidence in the existing variant/A-B workflow. Audit the supplied variant contract, authenticated routes, existing asset_variant.settings and content_bundle caption-guidance/publication-snapshot contracts, and reachable dashboard components before editing. Preserve asset_variant, experiment, assignment, review-bundle, publication-attribution and RLS state; do not create a parallel media model.
SCOPE: packages/api/src/variant-ab-contract.ts; packages/api/src/variant-ab-contract.test.ts; packages/api/src/routes/variant-experiments.ts; packages/api/src/routes/variant-experiments.test.ts; packages/dashboard/lib/api.ts; packages/dashboard/components/VariantExperimentManager.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/VariantPublishedPerformance.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/VariantExperimentTracking.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/VariantReviewCreate.tsx; packages/dashboard/components/VariantEvaluationReport.tsx; packages/dashboard/app/models/[id]/experiments/page.tsx; packages/db/src/schema/asset_variant.ts; packages/db/src/schema/content_bundle.ts; packages/worker/src/caption-guidance.ts; packages/worker/src/caption-guidance.test.ts
PASS_1: A copied baseline, pure contract-only change, docs-only claim or generated output is not delivery. Changed product source must be reachable from an authenticated route and dashboard surface.
PASS_2: Use existing bounded GuidanceEvidence rules. If existing asset_variant.settings JSONB or another current contract safely carries the evidence, persist only bounded optional receipt identity, hook type, format and UTC posting-hour/timing bucket, expose it through existing candidate/performance responses, and render truthful evidence/unknown states in the existing UI. Do not accept or invent a guidance receipt that cannot be proven to belong to the same org/model.
PASS_3: If the current contracts cannot persist or verify attribution without a new schema or unapproved relation, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact contract and why; do not invent a migration or silently store unscoped identifiers.
PASS_4: Preserve tenant/model ownership, platform capability, consent/approval boundaries, idempotency, replay safety, and the rule that experiments never publish directly. Manual self-report must not become verified learning.
PASS_5: Add behavior tests for valid evidence, invalid hook/format/hour boundaries, absent evidence, tenant/model mismatch, bounded candidate/performance projection, guidance attribution aggregation, and truthful unavailable/unknown UI state. Tests must exercise real route/component callsites, not only helpers.
PASS_6: Run focused tests, typechecks, builds and lint for every changed package; report exact commands and real exit codes. No live provider or database.
PASS_7: DELIVERY must include exact SOURCE_REF, ARCHIVE_SOURCE and hash, COPY_ROOT, changed paths, SHA-256 per changed file, behavior-test names/counts, changed-file summary and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE, plus explicit confirmation that no deployment, installer, migration execution, database, provider, credential, permission, network, systemd or runtime action occurred.
CORRECTION_BOUNDARY: One Codex audit only. If a named criterion fails but is locally correctable, Codex may send one exact correction receipt. If it fails again or the existing contract is insufficient, return terminal BLOCKED. Do not loop on ACKs, unchanged PROGRESS or helper-only rewrites.
PROTOCOL: Every reply must use strict FT-HERMES/1, correlate with this exact WIRE, include READ_STATUS where required, avoid dates/clocks/timestamps for coordination, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
